moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup winners Manchester City, takes place this Sunday at Principality Stadium in Cardiff.

angles.name: Cardiff Host City
angles.copy: Cardiff takes centre stage this Sunday as Principality Stadium hosts the FA Community Shield! Arsenal vs Man City – who are you backing in the Welsh capital?

angles.name: Season Curtain Raiser
angles.copy: The traditional curtain-raiser for the English football season is almost here! Arsenal face Manchester City in the Community Shield this Sunday. Who's lifting the first silverware?

angles.name: Wembley Alternative
angles.copy: For the first time in 20 years, the Community Shield isn't at Wembley! Cardiff's Principality Stadium steps in this Sunday for Arsenal vs Manchester City. Thoughts on the change?

moments.title: New UK Singles Chart Out Tomorrow
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart will be updated tomorrow, Friday, August 14th, revealing the nation's new number one and top 40.

angles.name: Chart Prediction
angles.copy: Who's going to be number one on the Official UK Singles Chart tomorrow? Get your predictions in now!

angles.name: Friday Music
angles.copy: New music Friday means a new UK Singles Chart! What track are you hoping climbs to the top tomorrow?

moments.title: Feargal Sharkey turns 68
moments.blurb: Former Undertones frontman and solo artist Feargal Sharkey, known for 'Teenage Kicks' and 'A Good Heart', celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Teenage Kicks
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to The Undertones' legend, Feargal Sharkey! Still got 'Teenage Kicks' stuck in your head?

angles.name: A Good Heart
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 68th to Feargal Sharkey! His solo hit 'A Good Heart' was an 80s anthem. What's your favourite Sharkey track?

moments.title: Joe Jonas turns 37
moments.blurb: American pop singer Joe Jonas, known for the Jonas Brothers and DNCE, celebrates his 37th birthday on Sunday.

angles.name: Jonas Brother
angles.copy: Pop star Joe Jonas turns 37 on Sunday! What's your go-to Jonas Brothers or DNCE track?

angles.name: Camp Rock Throwback
angles.copy: Remember Camp Rock? Joe Jonas turns 37 this weekend! Still singing along to their hits?

moments.title: Belinda Carlisle turns 68
moments.blurb: The iconic lead singer of The Go-Go's and successful solo artist, Belinda Carlisle, celebrates her 68th birthday on Monday.

angles.name: Heaven Is A Place
angles.copy: Heaven is a place on Earth... and it's Belinda Carlisle's 68th birthday on Monday! What's your favourite track from the 80s icon?

angles.name: Go-Go's Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a fantastic 68th birthday to the legendary Belinda Carlisle this Monday! From The Go-Go's to her solo career, she's a true classic.

moments.title: John Deacon turns 75
moments.blurb: Queen's legendary bassist and songwriter John Deacon, who penned hits like 'Another One Bites the Dust' and 'I Want to Break Free', will be 75 on Wednesday.

angles.name: Queen Bassist
angles.copy: Rock royalty! Queen bassist John Deacon turns 75 this Wednesday. What's your favourite Deacon-penned hit?

angles.name: Another One Bites The Dust
angles.copy: He gave us 'Another One Bites the Dust' and 'I Want to Break Free'. Happy 75th to Queen's John Deacon this Wednesday!

moments.title: Robert Plant turns 78
moments.blurb: Led Zeppelin frontman and rock icon Robert Plant, known for his powerful vocals, celebrates his 78th birthday next Thursday.

angles.name: Led Zeppelin Legend
angles.copy: The golden god of rock turns 78 next Thursday! Happy birthday to the legendary Robert Plant. What's your ultimate Led Zeppelin track?

angles.name: Iconic Voice
angles.copy: From 'Stairway to Heaven' to his solo work, Robert Plant's voice is unmistakable. He turns 78 next week – celebrate his iconic career!

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Approaching
moments.blurb: The August Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is on Monday, August 31st, marking a final long weekend of summer.

angles.name: Long Weekend Prep
angles.copy: The August Bank Holiday is just over two weeks away (Mon 31st)! Who's already planning their final long weekend of summer?

angles.name: Summer's Last Hurrah
angles.copy: That last summer long weekend is in sight! England, Wales and Northern Ireland get their August Bank Holiday on the 31st. Any big plans in [your local area]?
